title: Freedom in the Spirit
definition: Freedom in the Spirit is the liberty believers have in Christ from sin's dominion, condemnation, and slavery to the flesh.
summary: The Spirit brings freedom that leads to holiness, love, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus sets captives free, and the Spirit enables believers to live in that freedom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Freedom in the Spirit is not permission to serve the flesh. It is freedom from condemnation, sin's rule, and slavery to self-centered desires.

The Spirit leads believers into freedom that expresses itself through love, holiness, and obedience. True freedom is life under Christ, not autonomy from Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often define freedom as doing whatever they want. This doctrine matters because true freedom is the ability to live for God by grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand firm in the freedom Christ gives. Do not return to bondage through sin, shame, or legalism. Walk by the Spirit in love.
